severityDisclaimer: Prototype severity classification only; not a validated clinical decision-support severity scale.

rules.title: Lisinopril with elevated potassium
rules.finding: Elevated potassium is a medication-safety concern in a patient receiving lisinopril.
rules.thresholdNote: 5.7 mmol/L is used for this prototype because a current lisinopril label reports hyperkalemia in trials using serum potassium >5.7 mEq/L; this is not a universal treatment threshold.

rules.title: Metformin with eGFR below 30
rules.finding: Metformin is contraindicated at this level of renal impairment.

rules.title: Insulin with level 2 hypoglycemia
rules.finding: Glucose is in the ADA level 2 hypoglycemia range while the patient is receiving insulin.

rules.title: Warfarin with INR above 4
rules.finding: INR is above the level associated with increased bleeding risk in the warfarin label.
